name: Malott Family Zoo Intern Program
what_you_do: Interns teach zoo guests about animals and conservation. They learn how to share conservation messages. They meet zoo researchers and animal care staff. They finish with a project they present.
grades: Entering grades 10 to 12, or freshman year of college
who_can_apply: You must live in the city of Chicago. You must be going into grades 10 to 12 (or be a college freshman) in the fall. You must be 16 to 18 by the June orientation date. You must be allowed to work in the U.S. and have proof of identity.
pay_detail: Paid, 7 weeks. The page does not state the hourly rate.
duration: 7 weeks, Monday to Friday (June 22 to Aug 7 in 2026), plus a Saturday orientation
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Feb 1 to Mar 9. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the zoo SlideRoom link on the program page. Invited applicants go to a half-day group interview at the zoo in March. The zoo also held two Zoom info sessions in late Feb and early March in 2026.
notes: Interns do not work directly with animals. You need a reliable way to get to the zoo each day. You can apply to several zoo teen programs at once. The Illinois FAQ requires work permits only for workers under 16 and refers 16 and 17 year olds to federal rules. Contact is listed on the program page.
